title: The Regime-Consistent Measurement Principle (RCMP): A Methodological Framework for Multi-Scale Physics
abstract: Introduces the Regime-Consistent Measurement Principle (RCMP), a methodology for valid cross-regime measurements in multi-scale physics. The framework comprises five pillars: driver-proximity, regime-tagging, proxy-accounting, coordinate-humility, and cross-validation. Demonstrated with SPARC galaxy rotation curve data.

efc_context.regime_relevance: Measurement methodology ensuring validity across regime boundaries

key_results: Five-pillar RCMP methodology: driver-proximity, regime-tagging, proxy-accounting, coordinate-humility, cross-validation
Formal criteria for valid cross-regime measurement
Demonstration with SPARC galaxy rotation curve data
